strategy_lineage: macro-sahm-cpi-initial-release-v1; exactly one candidate; no search or optimization
hypothesis: Causal initial-release unemployment deterioration identifies recession conditions in which the portfolio should remain entirely in CashYieldCNY, while initial-release CPI inflation separates gold-favoring inflationary non-recessions from Nasdaq-favoring lower-inflation non-recessions.
data_readiness: The earlier DATA_BLOCKED state is explicitly resolved by e8c684760daab8c8b7e411f2586e1edae574ff63, which froze ALFRED initial-release UNRATE/CPIAUCSL rows and passed their validator. Coverage is 1999-12..2026-07 with the genuine 2025-10 gap retained.
allowed_changes: one immutable precomputed schedule replayed unchanged at both frozen costs
the fixed naturally drifting 50/50 control and fixed non-recession mapping-swap placebo
mechanical reporting of frozen evaluation windows and constraints
selection_metric: No optimization or selection. The sole frozen candidate is evaluated once; only App cost (1.00% fee plus 0.05% slippage) determines acceptance.
pass_fail_gates: At App cost, full-history, last-10-calendar-years, 2020+ and 2022+ CAGR each >=10%
At App cost, full-history, last-10-calendar-years, 2020+ and 2022+ MDD each <=10%
At App cost, full-history candidate Sharpe strictly greater than the naturally drifting 50/50 control and strictly greater than the swap placebo
the exact same immutable schedule fingerprint, event indices, dates, weights, reasons, reference months and macro row hashes are replayed at both costs
maximum requested and marked-to-market actual gross <=100%; weights, holdings and cash nonnegative; no shorting, leverage or financing
all frozen loader, schedule, causality, strict-T-1, real-observation, freshness and append-only contract tests pass
follow_up_policy: If any gate fails, record REJECTED and stop. Once performance is opened, no threshold, direction, weight, filter, window, lag, freshness, release timing, missing-data behavior, asset mapping, control, cost or other rescue is allowed. A different mechanism requires a new lineage and preregistration.
swift_engine_entrypoint: scripts/run_macro_sahm_cpi_formal.py -> tools/macro_sahm_cpi_formal.swiftpart + MacroInitialReleaseCSVLoader + MacroSahmCPIStrategy.makeSchedule -> BacktestEngine.runResearchTargetProviderStrategyWithTrace frozenSchedule -> shared BacktestDailySimulator
expected_outputs: BPS25 descriptive and App-cost candidate metrics for full history, last 10 years, 2020+ and 2022+
immutable candidate schedule CSV with fingerprint, event count, reference month and macro row hashes
portfolio paths, constraints, execution receipt, stdout/stderr and SHA-256 artifact manifest

candidate_definition.cash: all unallocated capital remains in existing CashYieldCNY
candidate_definition.unrate_rule: U3_m=(U_m+U_m-1+U_m-2)/3; S_m=U3_m-min(U3_m-1...U3_m-12); S_m>=0.50 percentage points targets 100% CashYieldCNY
candidate_definition.cpi_rule: pi_m=100*(CPI_m/CPI_m-12-1); when S_m<0.50, pi_m>=2.00% targets 100% gold_cny and pi_m<2.00% targets 100% nasdaq; equality uses >=
candidate_definition.warmup: 15 consecutive UNRATE reference months and 13 consecutive CPI reference months are required; otherwise 100% CashYieldCNY
candidate_definition.invalid_data: any missing, non-finite, conflicting duplicate or discontinuous required macro row makes that review cash; 2025-10 remains missing with no interpolation or backfill and subsequent classification must re-warm continuously
candidate_definition.availability: available_at is release_date plus one calendar day at 08:00 Asia/Shanghai; a market date is eligible only when its Shanghai day boundary is strictly later than both rows' available_at
candidate_definition.review: each reference month is reviewed once, on the first gold_cny+nasdaq+usd_per_cny common real-observation date after both releases are eligible; forward fill never advances review
candidate_definition.freshness: when the latest complete paired reference month is more than 62 calendar days past its month-end with no new complete pair, target cash on the next common real-observation date; 62 is fixed; recovery only follows an eligible valid pair and is not retrospective
candidate_definition.event_suppression: no event when the new target exactly equals the previous target; never rebalance natural drift
candidate_definition.execution: signal at s executes no earlier than the next common real executable date under strict T-1; closed markets remain pending; forward-filled rows cannot execute; Nasdaq CNY conversion requires same-session FX; sell before buy and defer cross-venue purchases to the next eligible session
candidate_definition.schedule: pure full-history immutable precomputation; events contain signalIndex, signalDate, targetWeights, reason, referenceMonth and both macro row hashes; callback lookup only; costs, holdings, cash, pending fills, portfolio value and callback count cannot alter future events
candidate_definition.constraints: long-only, no leverage, no financing, no shorting, gross<=1 and cash>=0

cost_models.schedule_identity: both costs must replay the exact same precomputed schedule object and fingerprint

evaluation_windows.full_history: all available frozen App fixture history after engine warmup
evaluation_windows.last_10_years: latest portfolio date minus exactly 10 calendar years through latest

controls.naturally_drifting_50_50: on the first valid warm classification execution, establish 50% gold_cny and 50% Nasdaq once, then never rebalance and allow natural drift
controls.swap_placebo: recession still targets cash; only swap the non-recession gold/Nasdaq mapping; all other timing, warmup, missing and freshness rules remain identical; cannot replace or rescue candidate

forbidden_changes: any alternate Sahm or CPI threshold, equality direction, formula, warmup, lag or release timing
any alternate mapping, weights, assets, filters or windows
any interpolation, backfill, revised macro vintage or forward-filled signal/FX observation
any freshness other than 62 calendar days or any retrospective recovery
any periodic or drift rebalance when target is unchanged
any leverage, financing, shorting or negative cash
any post-result rescue, neighborhood search or replacement in this trial
